Juno is a sweet 9 year old, 13 lb chihuaua mix. Her super power is comfort — she finds and the softest, coziest spot in every room and loves to be near humans to cuddle. She is the sweetest, most gentle pup, and I feel so lucky that we found each other back in 2018. In addition to human attention, she enjoys long spry walks under the palm trees, sitting at windows watching nature, and playing with her nylabones and dog friends! Juno is a respectful, house trained, quiet dog. She is a momma and she radiates that vibe. Juno is a warm addition to every pack she joins!

I am looking for training for my almost 3yr old lab, Louie. He did a boot camp at 7 months and is a fun, playful dog with a lot of energy. He is pretty easy going and loves to go on walks. For the last couple of years he has stayed at my cousins with their 2 labs during the week while I am working in WLA. I feel he needs to get some good training and I, as well, need to learn whatever skills are necessary. We routinely go to the dog park near my home in the Coronado Cays and he runs around, plays, and checks out the other dogs...when he is not sniffing all over the park. He plays catch, is easily distracted when he sees another dog to check out. Of late he has started growling at other dogs when they are on leash...he can be in my car or on leash with me on a walk. I don't know what to do for this. At the park he runs around and does not growl. So, I need training for that. I also would like to use your day care services, sports classes and excursions (he would love those!). If somebody could contact me at 310-753-7379 I would appreciate it.

warnings.allergies: seasonal environmental. he gets a shot for them as necessary
